[Intro]
[Dm]

[Verse 1]
[Dm]Leave me in the sun, I'm melting like a Popsicle
Give me the flu, I'm dying in this hospital
I need you close, but you got me backed against a wall
I try to speak, but my mouth doesn't move at all

[Pre-Chorus]
[Dm]Sing me right back to sleep
We'll never hear your voice break down again
Need you to try to keep
Your distance and I'll come home again

[Chorus]
[F]Run [C]away Don't
[Dm]let me run away, no
[F]Get [C]away Don't
[Dm]let me get away, no And when the
[F]lights come up and you [C]see I'm gone You wake
[Dm]up to an empty house [Bb]And when the
[F]music stops, and you [C]come undone You know I'm
[Dm]never gonna get you out of my head

[Verse 2]
[Dm]Met you in the dark, where we stumble in the mysteries
An opened book that you took and now I'm history
You moved away and you left me with your dying wish
I couldn't prove it was you, you're the arsonist
